# Font licences

**Generated by `scripts/audit_fonts.py` — do not edit by hand.**
Regenerate with `make fonts`. Last audited 2026-08-12.

Every family here is **SIL Open Font License 1.1**, which permits embedding in a commercially distributed PDF. The `fsType` column is read from each binary's OS/2 table rather than inferred from that licence — a font whose bits contradict its licence is a blocker, not a warning, and the audit exits non-zero.

The full licence text for each family sits beside the fonts as `<slug>-OFL.txt`.

## Reserved Font Names

OFL 1.1 §3 forbids distributing a *modified* version under the original name. We ship these files unmodified, so no renaming is required. If a font is ever subset-and-renamed, or hinted, or its metrics adjusted, it must be given a new name that does not include the Reserved Font Name.

| Family | Reserved Font Name |
|---|---|
| Source Serif 4 | Source |
| Source Sans 3 | Source |
| Archivo / Archivo Narrow | *(none declared)* |
| Noto Serif Devanagari / Noto Sans Devanagari | *(none declared)* |
| Mukta | *(none declared)* |
| Tiro Devanagari Hindi | Tiro |

> Subsetting for PDF embedding is not 'modification' under OFL §3 — it > produces an embedded instance, not a distributed font. Renaming is > required only if we distribute the font file itself in altered form.
